data.title: Akhanda
data.overview: Brothers Murali Krishna and Akhanda are separated at birth. They grow up to lead completely separate lives, Murali as a local hero, and Akhanda as a secluded Shiva devotee. But when the lives of Murali and his family are in danger, his long-lost brother finally returns.
data.tagline: When hope dies, when there is no faith, when evil spreads its wings, Akhanda arrives.
